about: SnowboardRecs starter catalog: snowboards and splitboards from 14 makers, 2024 to 2027 model years (2024 and 2027 added on 2026-10-24 at the owner's request), one entry per model and model year as evo.com names them, colourways and sizes merged, women's-only models kept under their own names, kids' boards left out. Read on 2026-10-24 from each board's evo.com product page. Category comes from evo's terrain list: Powder, or Freeride listed first, makes a Freeride snowboard; Freestyle listed first a Freestyle snowboard; otherwise All-mountain. Terrain, profile (evo's rocker type, in the maker's own words), shape and flex are as the page states them; blank where the page gives none or gives only sidecut tech. Nitro Team 2026's and Team Pro 2027's terrain come from nitrosnowboards.com, as evo's pages give none. Bindings and boots are not included: Burton and thirtytwo don't give them model years.
